{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|The problem in galactic society at large is not that there are too many poor sentients&mdash;it's that there are too few rich ones.|One of the philosopher's comments on the galaxy|<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>}}
'''Hyoca Lans''' was a philosopher who put forward the thesis about the problem of galactic society, that there were not too many poor people, but too few rich ones. He was mentioned by [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] artist [[Ves Volette]] in a [[memnis]].
